rules: No baked text on any cover - the page's own name says what it is
Medallion, five jewels and her face never change; only the scene carries the area
Compose jewels in the upper-middle band (target ~70% of frame height): the page's bottom fade and crop eat the lowest band
Any cover can be repositioned vertically by the page owner (the adjuster); the offset is saved per page

assets.note: Re-fitted by Resolve 2026-10-25: source was already panorama ratio; resized to slot. Dark premium variant - black medallion disc, star-cut jewels.
Re-fitted by Resolve 2026-10-25: source was already panorama ratio; resized to slot. Jewels sit low - the cover adjuster aligns it.
Re-fitted by Resolve 2026-10-25: 16:9 source cropped to the slot with medallion, jewel row and portrait ring whole. Her portrait-in-a-jewel-ring concept - strong for personal pages.

assignment_on_page_creation.any_other_page: next cover from the rotation set, cycling so the network does not repeat itself street by street

change_cover: pick any cover from the library shelf

adjuster.control: drag the cover up or down to align it
adjuster.applies_to: library covers and uploads alike - this is what makes any beautiful image fit, including taller art

owner_controls.custom_cover_service: A citizen can ask their Naya for a custom version made from their own photo, business or space - the library covers are the style it is made in

hosting.decision: The library ships as assets inside the app itself (versioned with the code that serves the pages) - no separate manual upload step, no extra account. Page creation references covers by key from this manifest. Citizen uploads live in user storage as today.
hosting.why: Maximum automation: a page is born with its cover because the cover travels with the system that creates the page.

facebook_share: Unchanged: shares keep the current standard card (obsidian field, medallion, the message text in the middle). The epic covers are page covers, not share images.

smart_factory_shelf.what: The whole library is browsable in Smart Factory as templates
citizen_choices: use any cover as-is on any page
use a cover as the reference and have their Naya make their own version
smart_factory_shelf.born_with_cover: Every personal, business and space page is built with its area cover already in - no upload required, ever
smart_factory_shelf.the_note_on_the_page: Feel free to change your cover - or use it as a reference to get your own version made.
smart_factory_shelf.principle: Everything by standard, the whole system always beautiful - and keep it simple
